name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Lemon Cherry Gelato
description:
Fruity, smooth, and seriously flavorful. The Mad Labs Lemon Cherry Gelato disposable brings a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Lemon Cherry Gelato is a hugely popular hybrid known for its rich, layered flavor. Expect sweet cherry and bright citrus up front, rounded out by creamy, dessert-like gelato smoothness on the finish. The effect is balanced and easygoing — a relaxed, feel-good calm paired with a gentle mood lift, making it a versatile pick that fits just about any time of day, from a mellow afternoon to a laid-back evening.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Lemon Cherry Gelato flavor — sweet cherry and citrus with creamy gelato smoothness
Balanced hybrid effects — relaxed, uplifting, and versatile any time of day

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Lemon Cherry Gelato is ready whenever you are.
